source: Weekly refresh by Claude (scheduled task). Edit freely; the next refresh replaces this file.

items.title: SAES Season Finale at Kyalami (13 to 14 Nov): motorsport hype reel
items.why: The Nine Hours of Kyalami weekend is the biggest local car event this month and fits the FOM automotive niche perfectly.
items.tip: Shoot pit lane prep and night laps, post a 15 second teaser the same night and tag the teams so they reshare.

items.title: Black Friday (27 Nov) mini-session offer that doubles as a Christmas gift
items.why: November is when people plan gift buys, so a clear deal with a deadline gets saved and sent to partners.
items.tip: Slide 1 the offer, slides 2 to 4 sample shots, last slide how to book and the cut-off date.

items.title: End of November race galleries: Soweto Marathon and Ride Joburg
items.why: Big Joburg races land at the end of the month and finishers go hunting for photos of themselves.
items.tip: Announce where you will stand before race day, then drop the gallery link that evening and ask runners to tag friends.

items.title: Festive market and lights series for local brands
items.why: Cozy early-Christmas content is trending from early November, and Joburg is full of Christmas markets and light shows from late November.
items.tip: Film a 3 clip vendor story at a market like KAMERS or Parkview and offer the stall a short promo package.

items.title: 'AI mock-up vs the real shoot' beat comparison
items.why: Side by side clips of an AI version and the real handmade thing, cut to the beat, are trending and show off real skill.
items.tip: Generate an AI image of your planned car or sport shot, then cut to your real frame on every beat so the real one clearly wins.

items.title: 'Planned vs reality' twist carousel
items.why: Carousels that build a story over a few slides and flip it on the last slide are being shared widely on TikTok right now.
items.tip: Start with the client mood board, then the messy setup and the bad weather, and finish on the hero shot.

items.title: Serious documentary-style narration of a tiny photographer moment
items.why: Treating a mundane moment with dead serious documentary music is a popular format and makes you relatable.
items.tip: Sit in a chair and narrate choosing between two almost identical frames like it is a true crime story.

items.title: Write posts people want to send, not just like
items.why: Instagram now weighs DM shares, saves and watch time more than likes, so shareable posts travel further.
items.tip: End captions with a send prompt like 'send this to the friend who needs new car photos'.

items.title: Edit bigger projects in Edits for Mac
items.why: Instagram launched a desktop version of Edits on 5 Nov with a multi track timeline, LUT import and 4K export with no watermark.
items.tip: Import your own colour LUT so every reel matches your photo grade, then publish straight to Instagram.

items.title: Year-end function teaser for venues and caterers
items.why: Late November and December are peak work party and event season in South Africa, and venues are booking content now.
items.tip: Tag the venue and caterer so they reshare, and pin a 'December dates open' comment.
